## Phase 7 Finding

CulturalFeats has 16 Taom*Model.cs overrides under Main/Features/CulturalFeats/Models/ with **zero behavior-hook tests**. The only test file (TAOM.Tests/Features/CulturalFeats/TaomCulturalFeatsDefinitionTests.cs) contains 8 structural reflection tests on feat definitions â€” no test exercises any GameModel override calculation logic.

## Severity rationale â€” P1
- 58 public methods across 16 models; ratio 0.14 (8 / 58).
- ADR-008 100% service-testability target is unmet at the architectural level: there is NO service for CulturalFeats; logic is inlined into 16 GameModel override bodies (Phase 6 #144 systemic rule-4 violation).
- 8 of 16 models call CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor directly from override body â€” cross-feature static coupling with zero test asserting per-call composition.

## Cross-feature references
- Phase 6 #144 (architectural â€” rule-4 violation, no service exists)
- Phase 6 #43 (CareerPassiveHelper coupling)
- Phase 6 #8 (TaomSettlementLoyaltyModel â€” the RevoltTuning consumer â€” untested)
- Phase 2 #135 (TaomPartySpeedModel P1 â€” unguarded Campaign.Current.MapSceneWrapper)

## Phase 9 fix sketch
1. Extract ICulturalFeatsService and refactor the 16 GameModels to delegate (Phase 6 #144).
2. Add per-model behavior tests for at least the calculation/multiplier logic; structural feat-definition tests already exist.
3. Add an integration test for the CareerPassiveHelper compose path (one model x one career x one race -> expected magnitude).

- [ADR-008](../docs/adrs/008-testability-requirements.md) â€” 100% service coverage

## Phase 7 Finding

WargAttackService exposes 4 public methods. **Two (HandleWargTargetHit line 32, WargAttack line 79) accept the sealed Agent type directly** â€” they are NOT unit-testable.

The test file itself documents this at lines 9-20: *cannot be covered by unit tests: Agent is sealed and cannot be instantiated or substituted outside the Bannerlord process.*

## Severity rationale â€” P1
- ADR-007 violation (sealed types must be wrapped by adapters) BLOCKING ADR-008 100% target.
- Production-code refactor is required before tests can be written â€” this is not a test gap, it is a test possibility gap.
- 2 of 4 public methods cannot be regression-protected.

## Phase 9 fix sketch
1. Introduce IAgentAdapter (or extend existing if one exists â€” verify before creating).
2. Refactor WargAttackService to accept IAgentAdapter parameters instead of Agent.
3. Add tests for the now-testable methods using Substitute.For<IAgentAdapter>().
4. Update all call sites (likely in Patch_*_WargAttack Harmony patches) to construct the adapter at the patch boundary.

## ADR
- [ADR-007](../docs/adrs/007-adapter-pattern.md) â€” adapter pattern (the violation being remediated)
- [ADR-008](../docs/adrs/008-testability-requirements.md) â€” the test target
